supersedes: WP4-LIFT-NI-v2 only as the current evidence-chain endpoint; v2 remains a valid, unchanged conditional transfer qualification.
purpose: Qualify the unchanged WP4-LIFT-NI-v2 spatial/KS transfer theorem using the project-owned WP4-MR-REPL-v1 planar NVE and non-Abelian differential-Galois certificate instead of an unreplicated published premise.
goal: Prove that the reproduced positive-mass planar obstruction is a differential subquotient obstruction for the translation-reduced spatial problem and that any complete shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family on the qualified KS atlas would descend to the forbidden physical family.
evidence_boundary: A PASS reruns and hash-identifies the exact v2 KS quotient, two-spinor product reduction, chart compatibility, fixed-energy Sundman conservation, shell-relative rank descent, collision-free restriction, reflection splitting, fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum planar reduction, normal differential subquotient, Galois quotient, and global-restriction arguments. It replaces the unreplicated planar premise with the independently qualified WP4-MR-REPL-v1 result. It does not establish ambient-only rank, gauge-dependent or chart-dependent integrals, explicit clock-dependent integrals, non-meromorphic or non-Liouville obstructions, nonzero-Xi magnetic dynamics, a general SO(3) quotient, zero angular momentum, triple-collision regularization, absence of individual additional integrals, or a classification of all trajectories.

inherited_source_manifest.policy: The published planar papers are retained as source-comparison evidence only; T9 depends on the WP4-MR-REPL-v1 PASS record.

model.physical_phase_space: The regular collision-free part U of the 12-dimensional total-linear-momentum-zero translation quotient of the spatial Newtonian three-body phase space, complexified on the declared algebraic distance cover.
model.physical_hamiltonian: H on U with three finite strictly positive masses and positive gravitational constant.
model.extended_physical_space: U_ext=U x T*R with coordinates (z,t,p_t), canonical form omega_U+d p_t wedge d t, dimension 14.
model.upstairs_chart: Each WP2-MULTIQ-v1 chart is T*(R4 x R4 x R), dimension 18, with two commuting cotangent S1 actions and momentum map J=(Xi1,Xi2).
model.regular_domain: J^-1(0), both selected spinors nonzero, and the third pair distance nonzero; the free T2 quotient is U_ext.
model.regularized_hamiltonian: K=g*(H+p_t) after quotient, with g=r12*r23*r31 nonzero on the regular domain.
model.physical_shell: S is J=0 and K=0; there K=0 is equivalent to p_t=-H.
model.variational_reduction_chain: Along the nonzero-angular-momentum planar Lagrange phase curve: spatial translation-reduced VE dimension 12; reflection-fixed planar VE dimension 8; tangent-to-L_z=k quotient by rotation dimension 6; normal quotient by phase-flow and energy directions dimension 4; the independently reproduced WP4-MR-REPL-v1 NVE is the final differential subquotient.

admissible_integrability.name: shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family
admissible_integrability.definition: On a connected T2-invariant regular open neighborhood N in an 18-dimensional lifted chart containing the physical lifted parabolic Lagrange phase curve, a family (K,p_t,Xi1,Xi2,F1,...,F5) of nine meromorphic first integrals is admissible when all nine pairwise Poisson commute; their covectors have rank nine on a relative dense-open subset of S intersect N; every Fi commutes with p_t, Xi1, and Xi2; and every Fi restriction to J=0 agrees under each frozen WP2 chart transition.
required_consequences: Clock independence from commutation with p_t.
T2 projectability from commutation with Xi1 and Xi2.
Single-valued physical functions from chart compatibility.
No rank supplied only by Xi or H+p_t away from the physical shell.

theorem_obligations.T1_single_ks_reduction: Re-run the exact Hopf/KS radius, vertical-kernel, Xi momentum-map, projected-rank, and zero-level canonical Poisson identities.
theorem_obligations.T2_product_and_extended_reduction: Re-run the 18 -> 16 -> 14 two-spinor product quotient and exact zero-level regularized-Hamiltonian factor identity.
theorem_obligations.T3_chart_gluing: Re-verify the frozen WP2 projection-transition identity and chart-independent descent contract.
theorem_obligations.T5_involution_transfer: Re-prove that upstairs pairwise involution descends, including allowed p_t dependence.
theorem_obligations.T6_shell_rank_transfer: Re-prove that shell-relative rank nine implies physical rank six and reject off-shell-only rank.
theorem_obligations.T7_collision_domain: Re-prove that extension across binary collision cannot evade an obstruction on the regular collision-free open set.
theorem_obligations.T8_spatial_variational_subquotient: Re-run the exact reflection block, fixed-nonzero-L_z quotient, and 12 -> 8 -> 6 -> 4 normal differential-subquotient checks.
theorem_obligations.T9_galois_quotient: Verify the WP4-MR-REPL-v1 generic derivation PASS, empty complete-integrability exceptional set, and non-Abelian identity component; then re-prove that virtual Abelianity of the full spatial variational group would force virtual Abelianity of this differential subquotient.
theorem_obligations.T10_global_implication: Re-prove only that a global admissible family on a domain containing the regular neighborhood would restrict to the locally forbidden family.

implementation_identity.production: The v3 package delegates to the exact hash-pinned WP4-LIFT-NI-v2 pure-rational certificate without modifying it.
implementation_identity.reference: The hash-pinned v2 SymPy reference is rerun directly and remains source-disjoint from both v2 and v3 production packages.
implementation_identity.proof: The hash-pinned complete v2 proof supplies T1-T10 transfer details; a v3 addendum proves the premise substitution and updated claim boundary.

negative_controls: A synthetic or status-only MR record lacking the reproduced generic derivation must fail T9.
Any changed v2 production, reference, or proof hash must fail implementation identity.

decision_policy.PASS: Every prerequisite, inherited source, exact implementation-identity, reproduced-premise, T1-T10, independent-reference, negative-control, proof, and claim-boundary gate passes under the frozen v3 implementation.
decision_policy.FAIL: Any hash mismatch, synthetic premise, missing generic reproduction field, transfer regression, exact-identity disagreement, control escape, proof gap, or claim overreach fails v3 and requires a successor.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: The project-owned WP4-MR-REPL-v1 planar obstruction transfers to the translation-reduced spatial positive-mass Newtonian three-body Hamiltonian: it is not completely integrable by meromorphic first integrals near the embedded fixed-nonzero-angular-momentum parabolic Lagrange phase curve. Consequently, the qualified WP2-MULTIQ-v1 atlas admits no complete shell-regular physically admissible meromorphic Liouville family on any domain containing that regular neighborhood.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SHORT_CLAIM: The three-body problem has no integrals.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_RAW_UPSTAIRS_CLAIM: The unreduced KS Hamiltonian admits no complete family without the shell-regularity, gauge, chart, and clock conditions.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_GLOBAL_CLAIM: The local phase-curve obstruction proves nonintegrability in every regularity class or classifies every trajectory.

invalidation: Any changed premise, transfer model, admissibility definition, source or prerequisite hash, implementation identity, theorem obligation, control, decision rule, or frozen v3 implementation invalidates v3. A failed frozen execution remains FAIL.
